lastRequest: Build a fullstack Knowledge Base and Note Taking app with Express REST API endpoints, Prisma database models for notebooks, tags, and rich markdown notes, and a clean dark-mode React dashboard with sidebar navigation, tag filtering, and instant search.

tasks.title: Database Modeling with Prisma and PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Design and apply Prisma schema for User, Notebook, Note, and Tag models including migrations.

tasks.title: Express.js API & Zod Schema Validation
tasks.description: Implement Express REST endpoints for Notebooks, Notes, and Tags CRUD with Zod validation.

tasks.title: Frontend Shell & State Management
tasks.description: Setup Vite-React, Tailwind UI, sidebar layout, and React Query integration with the Backend APIs.

tasks.title: Markdown Editor & Export Features
tasks.description: Build live-preview markdown editor with autosave, and export functionalities to PDF, Text, and JSON.

tasks.title: Fuzzy Search, Tag Filtering & Docker Setup
tasks.description: Integrate Fuse.js for client search, tag filters, docker-compose configuration, and end-to-end verification.
